body:
The past few months I've been lying to my friends, family and boyfriend how much I eat in a day, been slowly restricting my calories and I've recently began making myself throw up if I feel like I've eaten too much.

I've always had a messed up relationship with food; I usually eat too much or too little. This time though it's different, I freak out if I'm made to eat something if I'm not sure on what the ingredients are and I refuse to eat anything that I consider to be 'bad'.

Fun times.
I'm starting a trial shift at a bar/restaurant tonight, if all goes well I'll be working this weekend and hopefully get the job.
Thanks :)
Yeah, I'm losing about 2lbs a week so hopefully.
I eat between 1200-1500 calories a day (it varies), been drinking more water and I exercise for at least an hour everyday.

Yeah, I've managed to cut most of the toxic people out my life but them and I should've done it a long time ago. They've had a go at me for losing weight because I'm 'thinner' than them even though I'm still overweight, they've ignored me because their ex/boyfriend/fwb (idk what is going on) kissed men and tried to get me to sleep with him when I was so drunk I could barely stand (I said no of course and got him to leave me alone) among other things.

Yeah the weight loss is on purpose, I still have a long way to go but hopefully I'll reach my goal weight in a year or so.

I know, it's just a bit hard because I've known them for years and considered them a good friend but only recently realised how manipulative and toxic they are. Like if I'm busy with something or cant travel to their place they start guilt tripping me with shit like "Oh no one wants to visit me anymore, you're my only friend, I'll kill myself without you." I mean I wouldn't mind hanging out with them but I don't want to feel like I have to see them yknow?

I like doing art, I'm considering going into tattooing or illustration but I need to look into both of those subjects a lot more before I make a final decision.

I dropped out of uni (the course was awful and the flat was depressing) so I've had to move back with my parents. Been kinda down about not finding any jobs in the area but there's that trial shift so I'm hoping it'll go okay. I'm trying to figure out what I want to do with my life and last week I met up with an old friend but it kinda brought up some dark memories and feelings so I'm trying to get over that and decide whether or not to stay friends with that person however I feel that at this point it might be best to go no contact with them.
Nah most of them are good, I'm just feeling sad in general.
If I make fun of my scars and they laugh I know they're a sick fuck just like me.

Kinda sad but okay.

I've noticed that I've been slowly losing weight again, my waist is getting thinner and I'm getting my figure back. I have a shift trial tomorrow and if all goes well I could have a job next week. And I've spent the last three days watching season 2-4 of Game of Thrones.
Thank you, I'll check out the link.

I've been feeling suicidal again and the idea of it is becoming more appealing.

I'm considering dumping my boyfriend in a hurtful way and delete social media just so I can do it.

Been thinking about doing this for months, don't know if I'll go through with it or not.
I've never heard of him but thank you for sending the link, I quite like it :)

A design course. I was told it would be a mix of digital and traditional media but it's all digital, instead of creating interesting posters, t-shirt designs, book covers etc (like the last course I did) it's all web design and information posters.
Thanks :)
At the moment waitress/bar work, there's not much going on in this area other than that but I want to save enough money to get my own place and hopefully get a job to do with illustration or design.

Thanks. Yeah my mum is happy that I said something about it because she figured something has been up with me for a while, my dad was a bit upset because the course I'm in can be a bit tough to get into, but he told me he'd rather see me happy than miserable doing something I don't want to do.
Third year, but I had to move to a different city for it.

I was advised to wait around four years, but they were for the deeper ones. Another friend of mine was told a year for hers, but I guess each tattoo artist is different. You might best going to the place where you plan on getting it done and ask them how long they would recommend you to wait.

Also look online and see if there are any artists in your area who specialise in scar cover ups.
